verdict.rationale: Visual branching with conditions, filters, and merging parallel paths is a fair question for a workflow orchestration platform, so the axis applies. However, Temporal's own docs say it 'isn't a no-code Workflow engine — it is Workflows-as-Code', and nothing in the pack documents an ops-facing builder for conditional branches, filters, or parallel paths that merge back together. The Web UI is described only as a place to view executing workflows.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can branch a workflow with conditions, filters, and parallel paths that merge back together
